continuity.opening: Master Cherry discovers an unexplained block of wood in his shop.
continuity.closing: Pinocchio is free but alone; Geppetto is imprisoned because the crowd misunderstands him.
continuity.next: Pinocchio returns to an empty home and meets the consequences of hunger and disobedience.

learningObjective: Tell a connected cause-and-reaction story using vivid actions, time connectors, and emotional consequences.

beats.title: The Unexpected Voice
beats.purpose: Open with ordinary work interrupted by an impossible voice.

beats.title: A Very Peculiar Block
beats.purpose: Prove that the wood reacts like a mischievous child.

beats.title: Geppetto's Wonderful Plan
beats.purpose: Give Geppetto both a practical plan and an emotional need.

beats.title: An Insult and a Quarrel
beats.purpose: Let the wood cause comic trouble before it has a body.

beats.title: A Name for a New Boy
beats.purpose: Turn a block of wood into Geppetto's hope for a family.

beats.title: Pinocchio Takes Shape
beats.purpose: Reveal Pinocchio's lively character as each feature is carved.

beats.title: The Great Escape
beats.purpose: Convert first steps into an impulsive flight from home.

beats.title: The Wrong Man Goes to Prison
beats.purpose: End with Pinocchio free and Geppetto bearing the consequence.
